'''''Rhododendron mucronatum''''' is a [[rhododendron]] [[species]] native to [[China]], where it grows at altitudes of {{convert|2800-4500|m|ft|abbr=on}}. This [[evergreen]] shrub grows to {{convert|1-2|m|ft|abbr=on}} in height, with leaves that are [[lanceolate]] to ovate-lanceolate or oblong-lanceolate, 2–6 by 0.5–1.8 cm in size. The flowers are white, pink, or pale red.
